According to RIL's FY2025-26 Management Discussion and Analysis, the Oil and Gas business segment's EBITDA declined year-on-year. Specifically, "Revenues and EBITDA were down 5.4% and 10.1% respectively, primarily due to natural production decline in KG D6 leading to lower volumes and lower price realisation partly offset by increased CBM gas production." (Source: RIL FY2025-26 Management Discussion and Analysis, Business Performance, page 14, doc_key: ril-2025-26).

Summary:
- Segment: Oil and Gas
- EBITDA decline: 10.1% year-on-year
- Reason: Natural production decline in KG D6, lower volumes, lower price realisation, partly offset by increased CBM gas production

No other business segment was reported to have a year-on-year EBITDA decline in the Management Discussion and Analysis for FY2025-26.

- The company has two operational reportable segments: Power Generation and Consultancy.
- Out of the total operating revenue of ₹13,386.75 lakh, ₹13,338.86 lakh is derived from a single customer, Indian Railways.
- The revenue is mainly driven by the consultancy segment, which accounted for 89% of the operating revenue in FY2024-25.
- The consultancy revenue is recognized based on performance obligations satisfied either over time or at a point in time, with detailed criteria for each method.
- The company’s operations are entirely within India.
